description: This file defines classes for Google Vertex AI Embeddings integration, including a subclass that can strip new lines from input texts before embedding, and a node class for configuration and initialization.

classes.name: VertexAIEmbeddingsWithStripNewLines
classes.description: A subclass of VertexAIEmbeddings that adds functionality to strip new lines from input texts before embedding.

classes.name: GoogleVertexAIEmbedding_Embeddings
classes.description: A node class implementing Google Vertex AI Embeddings with configuration options and initialization logic.

methods.name: embedDocuments
methods.description: Embeds multiple documents, optionally removing new lines based on stripNewLines flag.

methods.name: embedQuery
methods.description: Embeds a single query text, optionally removing new lines.

methods.name: loadMethods.listModels
methods.description: Loads available model options for embeddings.

methods.name: loadMethods.listRegions
methods.description: Loads available region options for embeddings.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the embedding model with provided node data and credentials.
